title: General Moelner: the secret craft filled a reconnaissance gap until spy satellites took over

tellings.quote: General Moelner's advice at face value, uh this thing just filled a gap. And when it had done its job of filling the gap, they went back to spy satellites.

plain: A secret American craft is said to have been built to fill a gap in aerial spying, and once it had done that job the military went back to relying on spy satellites. A guest named Nick Cook, on an episode about claimed anti-gravity aircraft, tells Michels this is what a General Moelner advised him, and says he takes the general's word at face value. If true, it would explain why such a craft could exist and then fade from use.
